name: Greenhouse Job Board
summary: A company's public Greenhouse job board: open roles with descriptions, departments, offices and pay ranges, keyless.
notes: Keyless: the docs state Job Board GET data is public and needs no authentication. Only the application POST (not in this entry) needs a Basic-auth Job Board API key.
Every call is scoped to one company's board_token; there is no cross-company search. A wrong token returns 404.
Job ids in /jobs are the job post ids that /jobs/{job_id} takes.

endpoints.name: Get a job board
endpoints.summary: The organization's name and job board intro content.

board_token.description: The company's job board token: the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.

endpoints.name: List open jobs
endpoints.summary: Every published job on the board, with title, location, updated_at and absolute_url.

board_token.description: The company's job board token: the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.

content.description: true adds each job's full description, departments and offices.

notes: No paging is documented: the whole board comes back in one response, and content=true makes it much larger.

endpoints.name: Get a job
endpoints.summary: One job post: description, location, and optionally its application questions and pay ranges.

board_token.description: The company's job board token: the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.

job_id.description: The job post id from the jobs list.

questions.description: true adds questions, location_questions, compliance (EEOC, if enabled) and demographic_questions.

pay_transparency.description: true adds pay_input_ranges (the pay ranges the company published).

endpoints.name: List departments
endpoints.summary: Departments with the jobs in each.

board_token.description: The company's job board token: the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.

render_as.description: list (default) or tree, for nested offices or departments.

endpoints.name: List offices
endpoints.summary: Offices with their departments and jobs.

board_token.description: The company's job board token: the slug in boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>.

render_as.description: list (default) or tree, for nested offices or departments.
